message.text: I'm noticing the regex pattern isn't matching GenUUID correctly—the issue is that the negative lookahead for a dot before the word boundary doesn't account for the fact that a dot isn't a word character, so the boundary check fails when GenUUID is qualified with a package name like "util.GenUUID(".  I need to simplify the pattern to just look for the function name at a word boundary followed by an opening parenthesis, while skipping the function definition line itself.

args.command:
